def Program():
    # default parameters:
    global speed_mms    = 0.300
    global speed_degs   = 0.750
    global accel_mmss   = 3.000
    global accel_degss  = 1.200
    global smooth_radius_mm = 0.001
    # Program generated by RoboDK
    set_reference(pose([807.766544, -963.699898, 41.478944, -0.000000, 0.000000, -0.000000]))

    speed_mms    = 100.000

    popup("Setting air valve 1 on")
    TCP_On()
    sleep(1.000)
    movel([-41.62707,-8.89064,-30.01809,60.62329,49.66749,-258.98418],accel_mss,speed_mms,0,smooth_radius_mm) # move_id = 4
    movel([-37.52588,-6.32628,-34.59693,53.52525,49.24426,-251.44677],accel_mss,speed_mms,0,smooth_radius_mm) # move_id = 5

    popup("Setting air valve off")
    TCP_Off()
    sleep(1.000)
